info.name: Shortcloud
info.summary: Short, memorable links on your own domain that redirect to your share links or to any other address
Adrese scurte pe domeniul tău, care trimit la linkul de partajare sau la orice altă adresă
info.description:
Shortcloud turns every public share link into a short one, such as `https://cloud.example.com/go/abc1234`, that redirects to the real share URL. Short links are created automatically whenever a link share is made (from the web, the desktop or the mobile clients), can be copied and customised right from the sharing sidebar, and can be created by hand for any address from the Shortcloud page.
* Automatic short link for every new link share, with a "Copy short link" entry in the sharing sidebar * Public album links of Photos and Memories get short links too * Custom slugs (`/go/annual-report`) — the domain is fixed, the rest is yours * Extra short domains (`https://cc.link/abc1234`) served by the same server * QR code for every short link * Hit counter and last access, without storing visitor addresses * Links follow the share: a renamed share token keeps working, a deleted share answers "gone" * External targets are refused by default; the administrator can allow chosen hosts or any URL * Creation can be limited to groups; the administrator can pause creation while old links keep working * Disabling the app keeps every link stored; re-enabling brings them all back unchanged
The short address needs one rewrite rule in the web server. The administration page installs it into `.htaccess` with one click (Apache), keeps it there across upgrades, and shows the snippet for other setups.
info.author: Cristian Casapu
